content.text: Anthony - I sent an invoice for 4 Freep writers today to Chris Thomas
But as with last year, I can't hand out cards until I have the assurance that payment is on the way
So please ask him if he got the invoice and began to process it - the cards will arrive in early Feb.

the only reason I'm contacting you is because I asked the SE's of both the News and Freep to email me back today that they received the invoice - but only heard back from the News - hopefully it will go smoothly this year with the Freep payment
thanks for your help - hope you had a good off-season
